doctrine: Forge-owned offers are authoritative for their declared public_id. Remote legacy catalog sync may contribute other offers but may not erase or downgrade an owned offer.

offers.name: Worldstate Reality Delta
intent_terms: what materially changed around my assets
monitor external conditions affecting my facilities
ground my AI in current physical world changes
show me evidence backed changes in this region
track infrastructure and environmental conditions around my portfolio
give my agent a current world state feed
tell me what changed that matters to my routes
offers.problem: An organization or AI needs a continuously updated, evidence-backed picture of external conditions intersecting its assets, facilities, routes, regions, dependencies, industries, or topics without drowning in generic news and alert noise.
offers.inputs: A bounded non-personal scope containing regions, domains, assets, facilities, routes, infrastructure dependencies, industries, or topics. Data sources must be public or explicitly authorized.
offers.outputs: Worldstate snapshots and Reality Delta packets with relevant observations, materiality, evidence state, independent source-family count, timestamps, provenance references, and compact agent-ready changes.
offers.pricing: Commercial pilot packaging is under verification. No fixed machine-quotable price is approved.
offers.confirmation: Public discovery and pilot-scope preparation create no monitoring authority, source access, Passport grant, payment obligation, production authority, emergency authority, or external action. Customer monitoring requires separate scoped onboarding and explicit authorization.
offers.payment_authority: No direct Worldstate payment path is approved.
offers.invocation_status: SOURCE READY: Forge-owned Worldstate read-only pilot MCP is implemented at /mcp/worldstate for canonical offer inspection and bounded non-person pilot-scope preparation. It creates no monitoring authority, Passport grant, source access, checkout, payment, production mutation, emergency authority, or external action. Do not claim public runtime availability until an independent HTTPS canary verifies the deployed route.
